items.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. My A 45 AMG runs better than it ever has. Honest advice, clear pricing and the team know their stuff.

items.text: They rebuilt my CLA 45 AMG engine with all the updated parts. No more rattling chains. Smooth process and great communication.

items.text: Top lads, top job. Picked up and dropped off, engine rebuilt to an extremely high standard. 100% recommend.

items.text: From quote to collection couldn't fault them. Engine looks brand new inside. Warranty gives great peace of mind.
